Title: Slice Category is Isomorphic to Comma Category/Lemma 2

Let $\mathbf C$ be a [[Definition:Metacategory|metacategory]].

Let $C$ be an [[Definition:Object (Category Theory)|object]] of $\mathbf C$.

Let $\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C}$ denote the [[Definition:Identity Functor|identity functor]] on $\mathbf C$.

Let $\mathbf 1$ denote the [[Definition:One (Category)|category one]].

Let $F: \mathbf 1\to \mathbf C$ be the [[Definition:Covariant Functor|functor]] defined by:
{{DefineFunctor
|ob = $F* = C$
|mor = $F \operatorname{id}_* = \operatorname{id}_C$
}}

Let $\mathbf C / C$ denote the [[Definition:Slice Category|slice category $\mathbf C$ over $C$]].

Let $\paren{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow F}$ denote the [[Definition:Comma Category (General Form)|comma category $\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C}$ over $F$]].

Let $J: \paren{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow F } \to \mathbf C / C$ be defined by:
{{DefineFunctor
|ob = for each [[Definition:Object (Category Theory)|object]] $\tuple{E, *, g}$ in $\paren{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow F}$:
:$J \tuple{E, *, g} = g$
|mor = for each [[Definition:Morphism (Category Theory)|morphism]] $\tuple{k:E \to E', \operatorname{id}_*} : \tuple{E, *, g} \to \tuple{E', *, g'}$ in $\paren{\operatorname{id}_{\mathbf C} \downarrow F}$:
:$J \tuple{k, \operatorname{id}_*} = k$
}}

Then:

:$J$ is a [[Definition:Covariant Functor|covariant functor]]
